name: Rentista Visa for Remote Work (Visa Nómada)

qualifying_event.description: For foreign nationals performing autonomous professional or remote/digital/teleworking activities for a foreign employer, client, or company domiciled outside Ecuador.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of remote work relationship with a foreign employer/client or ownership of a foreign-registered company; proof of foreign-source income; health insurance with Ecuador coverage.

requirements.blocker_text: Foreign-source income of at least 3x Ecuador's Salario Básico Unificado (SBU) per month (USD 1,446/month at the 2026 SBU of USD 482), or 36x SBU annually.
Work must be for an employer, client, or company domiciled abroad, performed remotely/digitally/via telework.
National or international health insurance with coverage in Ecuador is required.

evidence_required.document: Proof of remote work for a foreign entity

sources.title: gob.ec (MREMH official portal) -- Rentista visa for remote work (Visa Nómada): 3x SBU/month or 36x SBU/year foreign-source income requirement, foreign-employer/client requirement, health insurance, up to 2-year duration renewable once
NMS Abogados -- Ecuador sets the 2026 Salario Básico Unificado (SBU) at USD 482/month

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ecuador). Distinct from ec_rentista_visa.json: this category requires an active remote-WORK relationship with a foreign entity (income from labour/services), whereas the general rentista visa covers passive income (pensions, rent, investments) with no work component -- both share the same 3x-SBU income structure and 2026 dollar-conversion caveat. work_rights modeled 'restricted' since the visa's own terms limit permitted work to the foreign employer/client relationship, not Ecuadorian employment -- the tier-1 source does not impose an explicit outright ban on Ecuadorian work but frames the category's entire purpose around foreign-domiciled work.
